name: idea.edit
description: Edits an idea's brief. A new hook carries to its post unless the post is out, since posted is final. A write made from an older copy is refused with the idea as it is now.
sql:
with edited as (
  update brandbase.ideas i set
    format = case when :fields::jsonb ? 'format' then :format else i.format end, pillar = case when :fields::jsonb ? 'pillar' then :pillar else i.pillar end, hook = case when :fields::jsonb ? 'hook' then :hook else i.hook end, angle = case when :fields::jsonb ? 'angle' then :angle else i.angle end,
    feature = case when :fields::jsonb ? 'feature' then :feature else i.feature end, image = case when :fields::jsonb ? 'image' then :image else i.image end, source = case when :fields::jsonb ? 'source' then :source::jsonb else i.source end,
    status = case when :fields::jsonb ? 'status' then :status else i.status end, why = case when :fields::jsonb ? 'why' then :why else i.why end, inspiration = case when :fields::jsonb ? 'inspiration' then :inspiration::jsonb else i.inspiration end,
    shots = case when :fields::jsonb ? 'shots' then :shots::jsonb else i.shots end, cut = case when :fields::jsonb ? 'cut' then :cut::jsonb else i.cut end, sharper = case when :fields::jsonb ? 'sharper' then :sharper::jsonb else i.sharper end,
    built_on = case when :fields::jsonb ? 'builtOn' then :builtOn::jsonb else i.built_on end,
    version = i.version + 1, updated_at = now()
  where i.id = :id and i.brand_id = :brand
  returning i.*
),
carried as (
  update brandbase.posts p set hook = :hook, version = p.version + 1, updated_at = now()
  from edited e
  where :hook::text is not null and p.id = e.post_id and brandbase.post_stage(p.id) <> 'posted'
  returning p.id
)
select brandbase.camel(to_jsonb(e)) || jsonb_build_object('createdAt', brandbase.iso(e.created_at), 'updatedAt', brandbase.iso(e.updated_at)) as result from edited e
